_comment: ESM output imports each external module at the start of the chunk. IIFE and UMD output get an external module as a global or as a wrapper argument. A deferred import thus cannot delay `ext-lazy`, which the deferred module `d.js` imports, and Rolldown lowers the deferred imports of the build, with a warning. The builtin module `node:path` does not count: its early evaluation is not observable.
